gates.name: Provenance
gates.rule: every input row carries an official URL and a read date
gates.evidence: 32/32 standings rows and 231/231 depth slots carry an official URL and 2026-11-14; 326/326 injury rows keep the 2026-11-13 URL from the ledger

gates.name: Internal arithmetic
gates.rule: the publisher's own row must reproduce W+L+T, PCT and NET PTS
gates.evidence: 32/32 rows reproduce PCT and NET; league identity PF==PA==6291 and W==L==136

gates.name: Temporal integrity
gates.rule: no input may post-date the projection it feeds
gates.evidence: the Week 10 Thursday fixture was already settled when this snapshot was read; a strategy evaluated on that fixture would be using a result

gates.name: Coverage and power
gates.rule: at least 153 settled independent bets are required to distinguish a 60% true rate from break-even at 80% power
gates.evidence: 0 settled bets exist; the required threshold computed from the binomial is 154

gates.name: Forecast skill over a stated reference
gates.rule: a proper score must beat a stated naive baseline out of sample
gates.evidence: Pythagorean residuals are indistinguishable from null noise: chi-square 19.0254 on 32 df, p=0.966189

gates.name: Leg dependence measured, not assumed
gates.rule: a parlay or combo may be priced only after its joint dependence is measured on settled legs
gates.evidence: no leg-level settlement data exists; the correlations that can be measured are club-level and are labelled as a different quantity

gates.name: Multiplicity controlled
gates.evidence: 3 correlations computed, each with a Fisher interval and a Holm-adjusted p-value; the count of trials is published

gates.name: Executable price
gates.rule: a timestamped, settlement-complete price from an identified operator
gates.evidence: NFL.com publishes no odds and the rights question XS09 is unsettled, so no price has been retrieved and none may be computed
gates.produced_by: none: this is a rights constraint, not a data gap

gates.name: Forward shadow record
gates.rule: a dated, prospective, stake-capped record before any reward
gates.evidence: 0 shadow bets; a forward record cannot be created retrospectively

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: every artifact regenerates byte-identically from the committed evidence
gates.evidence: collect.py, depth.py, index.py, luck.py, ledger.py all support --check and are run in CI

gates.name: Depletion measured, not asserted
gates.rule: an injury claim names the player, the printed rank and the next printed name
gates.evidence: 265 of 326 injury rows matched a printed slot; 8 printed starters are ruled Out

gates.name: Blanks preserved
gates.rule: a value no official source publishes stays blank and is flagged
gates.evidence: Houston has no readable chart on two independent reads and stays blank; 301 of 326 injury rows keep a blank game status

note: Every gate is produced by a script over committed data. A gate that no data can test is 'blocked', never 'pass'.
reward_statement: No monetary reward is defined or paid. Non-monetary merit points would still require V4, V5 and V9 to pass first.
